- violet-blue grass and soil,
- moonlit pond pockets,
- flower beds,
- dark hedges,
- crooked trees,
- glowing mushrooms,
- tiny firefly lights,
- low mausoleum garden at one corner,
- star-flower shrine zone at another corner,
- scattered stones and roots.

The middle 70% of the image must stay visually calm and mostly flat terrain so roads can be composited later. No white stone ribbons, no tiled walkways, no road-like negative spaces.

Style: playful premium casual-game cartoon, chunky simplified forms, crisp silhouettes, saturated twilight palette, soft cel shading, high mobile readability, original IP, no realism, no Kingdom Rush imitation.
